description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Slap Dslh ParamTree object, used within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) of the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It provides function prototypes for creating, removing, and initializing the object, as well as retrieving its associated mapping and descriptor handles.

methods.name: SlapCreateDslhParamTree
methods.description: Creates a new Slap Dslh ParamTree object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the call map handle for the Slap Dslh ParamTree object.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor handle for the Slap Dslh ParamTree object.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Slap Dslh ParamTree object.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified Slap Dslh ParamTree object.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Slap Dslh ParamTree instance.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Slap Dslh ParamTree object.
